parts.name: pituitary gland
parts.hint: The small gland hanging beneath the brain — it releases hormones.

parts.name: thalamus
parts.hint: The central relay that passes signals up to the outer layer.

parts.name: fornix
parts.hint: The thin arch under the great band that carries memory signals.

parts.name: corpus callosum
parts.hint: The thick curved band of fibres joining the left and right halves.

parts.name: hypothalamus
parts.hint: The small control centre for hunger, temperature and hormones, just above the hanging gland.

parts.name: midbrain
parts.hint: The top of the stem, just under the central relay — eye movement and reflexes.

parts.name: pons
parts.hint: The rounded bulge of the stem that links across to the little brain behind.

parts.name: medulla oblongata
parts.hint: The lowest part of the stem into the spinal cord — breathing and heartbeat.

parts.name: cerebellum
parts.hint: The ridged “little brain” at the back — balance and coordination.

parts.name: cingulate gyrus
parts.hint: The curved fold wrapped just above the great connecting band.

parts.name: temporal lobe
parts.hint: The lower lobe at the side — hearing and memory.

parts.name: frontal lobe
parts.hint: The front — planning, deciding and voluntary movement.

parts.name: parietal lobe
parts.hint: The upper middle — touch and knowing where the body is.

parts.name: occipital lobe
parts.hint: The very back — where seeing is understood.
